rollback_evidence: Live write and return on ExtremeXOS 33.7.1.6 (2026-11-14 / 2026-11-19): The physical switch accepted permanent PoE disable and its undo; the cycle restored the starting state. Per-port update and the poe-cycle operation use disable/enable inline-power ports N behind a timed UPM safeguard such as 'enable inline-power ports N' with 'configure cli mode persistent'. Measured on X435-8P-4S and X440-G2-12p-10G4 with ExtremeXOS 33.7.1.6-patch1-11: 'disable inline-power ports N' adds that line in module poe and 'enable inline-power ports N' removes it (configuration equal to before); the port state reads searching for about 1 s after disable, then disabled, and searching again 3-4 s after enable; a port without PoE answers 'Error: Port N is not inline-power capable'. reset inline-power ports N is not used: it is silent (empty output, rc 0) on a port without PoE and its off time varied from 3 s to 40 s. Not measured: the delivering state with a real powered device and the time until such a device is powered again; the operation then waits for it with at most 60 s of pauses between reads of the check account and reports the observed state; the time of each read comes on top of the pauses (with 31 reads budgeted at 2 s each about 122 s), so 60 s is not an upper bound of the wait.
